placements.role: Independent refiner supplying unbranded transportation fuels, which is the diesel-producing conversion stage of this chain.

Refiner and energy importer at the chain's anchor: its crude feedstock cost is set by the Hormuz-disrupted market, and its margin is set by product markets above it. On this occurrence product prices outran crude for US refiners, which the cited result records.

business_summary: PBF ENERGY INC. (NYSE: PBF) states it is one of the largest independent petroleum refiners and suppliers of unbranded transportation fuels. It carries 2 chain/link placement(s): russian-diesel-ban/conversion-capacity (OVER_CROWDED, not money_corner); hormuz-maritime/cargo-owners-and-energy-importers (CROWDED, not money_corner). Fundamentals this run: latest fiscal-year revenue 29,332,300,000, -14.44% 3-year revenue CAGR, -0.19% operating margin.

exposure_summary.narrative: PBF Energy has 2 placement(s): russian-diesel-ban/conversion-capacity, the chain's single money-relevant node per its own heat map text ('this chain's actual scarcity: hydrocracking and deep desulfurization capacity, not crude, decides who can make on-spec ultra-low-sulfur diesel'), scored OVER_CROWDED with the chain's highest impact (95) and capture (80); and hormuz-maritime/cargo-owners-and-energy-importers, the same refiner-as-cost-and-margin-anchor role shared with Phillips 66 and Valero. No chain-specific or link-specific revenue percentage is disclosed or sourced for this issuer; only company-wide fundamentals are available, and FY2025 revenue and operating income both declined sharply from the 2022 peak.
